After persist- ent neurotoxicity or recovery from severe adverse ef- fects licensed product information recommends an in- itial reduction to 65 mg/m2 in metastatic colorectal cancer, and to 75 mg/m2 when given as adjuvant treat- ment. Oxaliplatin should always be given before fluor- opyrimidines. Oxaliplatin is under investigation for the treatment of ovarian and lung cancer.
